description: This file defines the MaintenanceModeSubscriber class, which subscribes to kernel events to handle maintenance mode behavior in a Drupal application, including displaying maintenance pages and logging mode changes.

classes.name: MaintenanceModeSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that manages maintenance mode behavior during kernel requests and termination events in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for maintenance mode handling, messaging, URL generation, user account, rendering, logging, and state management.

methods.name: onKernelRequestMaintenance
methods.description: Handles incoming requests to display maintenance page or send maintenance mode events based on conditions.

methods.name: onMaintenanceModeRequest
methods.description: Returns a maintenance page response when the site is in maintenance mode and the request is for HTML.

methods.name: onTerminate
methods.description: Logs changes to maintenance mode status after request processing.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves the logger service for logging maintenance mode changes.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Defines the events this subscriber listens to, including request, exception, maintenance mode request, and terminate events.
